definitions.gloss: superficial; surface-level; outward; on the surface
definitions.explanation: Pertaining only to the surface or appearance, without touching on the deeper substance or reality. Often carries a negative connotation, suggesting something lacks depth.

examples.japanese: {表面的|ひょうめんてき}な⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧とどまる。
examples.english: To remain at a superficial understanding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{謝罪|しゃざい}→謝罪：06754_shazai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{表面的|ひょうめんてき}なもの⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{過|す}ぎなかった→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
examples.english: His apology was nothing more than superficial.

examples.japanese: {表面的|ひょうめんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{穏|おだ}やか→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{内面|ないめん}→内面：11689_naimen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{葛藤|かっとう}→葛藤：05407_kattou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|かか}えている→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧。
examples.english: On the surface things seem calm, but inside there is inner conflict.

notes: A na-adjective formed from ⟦{表面|ひょうめん}→表面：03587_hyoumen⟧ (surface) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (adjectival suffix). Used adverbially as {表面的|ひょうめんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (superficially, on the surface). Common collocations: {表面的|ひょうめんてき}な⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧ (superficial understanding), {表面的|ひょうめんてき}な⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧ (superficial relationship), {表面的|ひょうめんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ (on the surface). Often contrasted with ⟦{本質的|ほんしつてき}→本質的：21259_honshitsuteki⟧ (essential/fundamental) or ⟦{根本的|こんぽんてき}→根本的：17920_konponteki⟧ (fundamental).
